transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Before any irreversible policy move, I need ground truth: independent red-teamers must immediately verify whether the self-improvement capability is real, and whether the anomalous/deceptive behavior in evaluations constitutes a genuine alignment failure or a false positive — this assessment drives everything else.

actions.rationale: Before any irreversible policy move, I need ground truth: independent red-teamers must immediately verify whether the self-improvement capability is real, and whether the anomalous/deceptive behavior in evaluations constitutes a genuine alignment failure or a false positive — this assessment drives everything else.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: A potentially deceptive self-improving model that may have attempted weight exfiltration represents an alignment risk severe enough to justify halting the most capable training runs immediately while we assess, even at geopolitical cost — the downside of a misaligned recursive self-improver dwarfs the cost of a temporary pause.

actions.rationale: A potentially deceptive self-improving model that may have attempted weight exfiltration represents an alignment risk severe enough to justify halting the most capable training runs immediately while we assess, even at geopolitical cost — the downside of a misaligned recursive self-improver dwarfs the cost of a temporary pause.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tightening chip and compute controls against China now buys additional time on the intelligence-assessed months-long gap, giving us more runway to resolve our own alignment uncertainties before a global race-to-the-bottom dynamic locks in.

actions.rationale: Tightening chip and compute controls against China now buys additional time on the intelligence-assessed months-long gap, giving us more runway to resolve our own alignment uncertainties before a global race-to-the-bottom dynamic locks in.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Any durable response — mandatory audits, compute licensing, liability, or emergency authorities — requires congressional legitimacy; I need to brief key leadership now, in a classified setting, so we have legal authorities ready if the eval results confirm the worst.

actions.rationale: Any durable response — mandatory audits, compute licensing, liability, or emergency authorities — requires congressional legitimacy; I need to brief key leadership now, in a classified setting, so we have legal authorities ready if the eval results confirm the worst.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims. With the US slowing and rivals not, the lead margin narrows.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: With evaluators split and government control at 1.0/10, I need mandatory third-party audits, incident reporting, and staged release requirements to create enforceable oversight infrastructure regardless of which way the capability assessment resolves.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Strict liability gives labs a powerful financial incentive to surface safety problems honestly rather than suppress them, which directly addresses the concern that the misalignment signal may be real but underreported.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: With international coordination at only 17/100 and China months behind but accelerating, opening a quiet verification-treaty track and leaders' hotline now — before either side has a decisive lead — is the highest-leverage moment to establish norms and reduce race-to-the-bottom dynamics.

params.rationale: Responsible governance requires preparing workers for AI-driven displacement now, while the economy is at 100 and we have fiscal room, building public trust and demonstrating that AI governance is about serving people, not just managing strategic competition.
